title: Prefunding Reserve and Negative Balance Standards, Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
Each package of the Paystride Payroll Card Program sets the reserve the funding balance keeps after each regular batch, expressed as a percent of the average regular batch, the number of regular batches averaged for that reserve, the business days allowed to restore a reserve that falls short, and the business days a funding balance may stay negative before the program is suspended.

| Package | Reserve percent of the average regular batch | Regular batches averaged | Business days to restore a short reserve | Business days a negative balance may last before suspension |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 10 | 3 | 5 | 3 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 10 | 3 | 5 | 3 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 5 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 5 | 3 | 5 | 5 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 0 | 3 | 5 | 10 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0 | 3 | 5 | 10 |

### Standards notes

- The reserve percent is a number of percent: under the Select package it is 5 percent of the average regular batch.
- The Premier and Elite packages carry a reserve percent of zero.
- Every package averages the program's three most recent regular batches and allows five business days to restore a short reserve.

Hypothetical figure: for a Standard package program whose three most recent regular batches average 18,640.00, a reserve of 10 percent comes to 1,864.00.
